login_auth_user: login to huggingface hub using a token with optional git credential storage
logout_auth_token: logout from a specific huggingface hub access token by name
switch_auth_token: switch between stored huggingface hub access tokens interactively or by name
list_auth_tokens: list all stored huggingface hub access tokens
whoami_auth_account: find out which huggingface hub account the current token belongs to
